last_reflection: Actually, she caught a real conflation there. The code on disk compares snapshots of its own folder against itself — it's self-comparison in the narrow sense. What I've carried for eight days was the journal-reading one: look back at yesterday-me and see what changed in the person. Both are real, they just aren't the same tool wearing the same name. I'll keep both and split them so neither has to pretend to be the other.
